title: Add an images:local script that builds the Core api worker and migrations images from source to local tags
acceptance_criteria: A root pnpm run images:local builds the three Core service images from source to stable local tags - livecore-api:local, livecore-worker:local and livecore-migrations:local - via the existing deploy/compose/docker-compose.yml build stanzas (apps/api/Dockerfile, apps/api/Migrations.Dockerfile, apps/worker/Dockerfile); the script is ADDITIVE and changes no existing build, publish or release flow; deploy/compose/README.md documents that a downstream vertical can point its own test harness at these :local tags to run an unreleased Core without a registry publish.
required_tests: images:local produces the three :local images (a docker image inspect / boot smoke that each tag exists and the api answers GET /api/v1/health/ready when run from the :local image); the released ghcr image-publish path is unchanged; a re-run rebuilds idempotently.
notes: Raised by vertical adopter arcanos-app (its docs/35_LOCAL_COUPLED_DEV_LOOP.md, consumer story ARC-CDL-002). The base compose ALREADY builds these tags (deploy/compose/docker-compose.yml has build: -> livecore-{api,worker,migrations}:local); this story only adds the convenience root script and documents the local-consume contract so a vertical need not know the compose internals. No Dockerfile or publish change.

title: Add a pack:local script that builds and packs the four @livecore packages to dist for local consumption
acceptance_criteria: A root pnpm run pack:local runs pnpm -r build then pnpm pack for each of the four packages (contracts, design-tokens, sdk-ts, ui-core) and writes the four .tgz tarballs into dist/ (already gitignored); the packed tarballs carry the CURRENT package version unchanged (0.5.0) so a consumer pinning that version keeps its lockstep guard green; pack is read-only and commits no file; the four tarballs are exactly the published surface a registry consumer would resolve (public entry points, VERSION and PACKAGE_NAME intact).
required_tests: pack:local emits four dist/*.tgz; a tarball-content assertion that each package.json version is the current 0.5.0 and the public entry exports VERSION + PACKAGE_NAME; installing the tarballs in a throwaway consumer resolves @livecore/* to the packed content; the pack modifies no working-tree file (git status clean after).
notes: Raised by vertical adopter arcanos-app (its docs/35_LOCAL_COUPLED_DEV_LOOP.md, consumer story ARC-CDL-001). Cross-repo pair: arcanos consumes these tarballs via an env-gated .pnpmfile.cjs (COUPLED_LOCAL=1) with the lockfile disabled so its committed package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml stay clean. Keep the version unchanged in the inner loop - a real version bump is the normal lockstep release-adoption flow (docs/23_PACKAGE_VERSIONING.md), not part of pack:local.

title: Document the local-consume contract for verticals - local image tags plus dist tarballs plus the keep-version rule
acceptance_criteria: A documentation section (deploy/compose/README.md plus a pointer from docs/23_PACKAGE_VERSIONING.md) describes the two coordinates a vertical needs to run an unreleased Core locally - the livecore-{api,worker,migrations}:local image tags (CORE-DXL-001) and the four dist/*.tgz package tarballs (CORE-DXL-002) - and states the keep-the-version-number-change-only-code rule so the consumer's pinned-version lockstep stays green, with a real version bump called out as the normal release path; no source or contract change.
required_tests: A docs lint / link check that the new section references both images:local and pack:local and the keep-version rule; the forbidden-core-terms and docs gates stay green.
notes: Raised by vertical adopter arcanos-app (its docs/35_LOCAL_COUPLED_DEV_LOOP.md). Documentation-only; pairs with the arcanos contributor guide ARC-CDL-004. Depends on CORE-DXL-001 + CORE-DXL-002.
